station_info.description: Comprehensive verified timetable of all passenger train services arriving, terminating, or halting at Veraval Junction (VRL). Includes complete intermediate stop-by-stop itineraries, platforms, frequencies, running days, and full source audit data.

conflicts: etrain.info live timetable shows destination as Veraval (VRL) due to Somnath (SMNH) physical closure.
trains.notes: etrain.info's row for this direction lists destination as VRL (not SMNH), inconsistent with the 19251 direction. Somnath (SMNH) station has been closed for redevelopment since approx. 1 Sept 2022 (multiple independent sources confirm it remained closed as of mid-2026: ixigo's SMNH station page, dated Aug 2026, states no trains currently pass through it; IndiaRailInfo forum posts and Wanderlog site reviews describe it as under reconstruction with all services diverted to Veraval Junction). The public timetable record for this train still names/routes it to SMNH with Veraval shown as a very brief (1-5 min) intermediate halt, but since SMNH is not physically operating, the currently effective terminus/origin for this service is Veraval Junction (VRL). This is recorded as an unresolved conflict rather than silently corrected.

conflicts.source_1: etrain.info (2026): train not listed at VRL at all
Wikipedia: AC 2 tier, AC 3 tier, Sleeper, General

trains.notes: This train number pair does NOT appear in etrain.info's current 42-train Veraval station listing (which states it is complete: 'Listed: 42 / Found: 42'), which is the strongest single piece of evidence gathered. However, erail.in (dated Aug 2026) lists it as running Daily with General/Unreserved class only. Older IndiaRailInfo news flags from 2020-2022 said 'Not running.' Wikipedia describes it as a daily service with AC/Sleeper classes, which conflicts with erail.in's Unreserved-only classification. Net assessment: this may be discontinued, may have been consolidated into the 59421-59424 Rajkot-Veraval Passenger pairs (an old rake-sharing note links 19569/19570 with 59421-59424), or may be a genuinely separate, lower-profile service that simply wasn't captured in the etrain.info crawl. Status could not be resolved with confidence in this research pass.
